front: Khái niệm 'Phrasal Verbs (Cụm động từ)' trong Unit 1: Local Community & Traditional Crafts được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
A verb combined with an adverb or a preposition that creates a meaning different from the original verb.

💡 Ví dụ: pass down (truyền lại), look around (ngắm nghía xung quanh), set up (khởi nghiệp/thành lập), live on (sống dựa vào).
🌱 Bản chất: Mastering phrasal verbs makes English speaking and writing sound natural and authentic.

front: Khái niệm 'Complex Sentences with Adverb Clauses' trong Unit 1: Local Community & Traditional Crafts được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Sentences containing an independent clause and at least one dependent clause introduced by subordinator: because/since (reason), so that (purpose), although (concession).

💡 Ví dụ: Although the pottery was handmade, it was sold at an affordable price.
🌱 Bản chất: Used to link ideas logically in essays and descriptive paragraphs.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Adverb clauses of purpose with 'so that' / 'in order that''?
back:
Subject + Verb + so that + Subject + can/could/will/would + Verb (bare infinitive).

📝 Ví dụ: We woke up early so that we could catch the first bus to Bat Trang ceramic village.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Expresses the specific goal or aim of the action in the main clause.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Rewrite the sentence using the phrasal verb in brackets: 'My grandparents started this workshop twenty years ago.' (SET UP)'?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Bước 1: Nhận diện động từ 'started' ở thì quá khứ đơn (Past Simple).
Bước 2: Cụm động từ tương đương là 'set up' (quá khứ của set vẫn là set).
Bước 3: Viết lại câu: 'My grandparents set up this workshop twenty years ago.'

👉 Kết luận: My grandparents set up this workshop twenty years ago.

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Using 'although' and 'but' together in the same sentence: 'Although he was tired, but he finished the craft.'?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Using 'although' and 'but' together in the same sentence: 'Although he was tired, but he finished the craft.'

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: In English, never use 'although' and 'but' in the same sentence. Remove 'but': 'Although he was tired, he finished the craft.'
